levers.how: Speak at the two budget public hearings (6:00 p.m., School Board Administration Building auditorium, 1450 NE 2nd Avenue): the July hearing tentatively adopts the millage and budget (2026: July 29, items SP-1 and SP-2), the September hearing adopts them finally (2026: September 9, item E-16). Two spring budget workshops come first (2026: May 20 and June 10 at 10:00 a.m.).
levers.rules: Register with a written request to the Superintendent (Room 102 or request4appearance@dadeschools.net) by noon the business day before a special meeting. The June 10, 2026 workshop deck says 'Over 80% of all funds goes to salaries and benefits' and set a $63.5 million reduction target.
levers.deadline: Noon the business day before the hearing; tentative 2027 dates are July 28 and September 15

levers.how: Positions are set each year in the School Allocation Plan (approved with the tentative budget, item SP-2) and the Executive Summary budget book's FTE-by-program and appropriations-by-object tables; the Board also approves the organizational chart and administrative pay plan as separate items. Section 1011.035(2), Florida Statutes, requires a plain-language budget with staff ratios posted 'prominently' on the district website.
levers.rules: The tentative budget item refers readers to the 'FY 2026-27 Tentative Budget Workpapers' and the School Allocation Plan; neither is linked from the agenda PDF.

levers.how: Payroll by position and the check register are public records under Chapter 119, Florida Statutes. Ask the district's records custodian through the Citizen Information Center (Room 102, 1450 NE 2nd Avenue, Miami 33132) or the Office of the Superintendent; the district has no online checkbook.
levers.rules: Fees for labor and copies may be charged under s. 119.07. The district's records-request page (ehandbooks user guide 147) requires JavaScript and could not be read here.

levers.how: Contract awards over the Superintendent's authority are E-series agenda items (bids, ITNs, grant service agreements) voted at the monthly regular meeting (usually a Wednesday at 11:00 a.m.). Register with the Request for Appearance form to speak on an agenda item.
levers.rules: Bylaw 0169.1: 3 minutes per speaker; requests due by 4:30 p.m. the Monday before the meeting; agenda posted about 9 days ahead.
levers.deadline: 4:30 p.m. the Monday before the meeting

levers.how: Each tentative agreement is ratified by the Board as a D-series item after the unit votes (for example D-22, D-24, D-25 on November 19, 2025 and D-24 on December 17, 2025). Speak on the item with a Request for Appearance.
levers.rules: Current addenda for AFSCME, DCSAA and DCSMEC run through June 30, 2027; the UTD master contract ran through June 30, 2026.
levers.deadline: 4:30 p.m. the Monday before the ratification meeting

levers.how: The Office of Management and Compliance Audits (305-995-1318) audits schools and departments and reports to the Audit and Budget Advisory Committee, whose agendas and the Annual Comprehensive Financial Report are posted at mca.dadeschools.net. The Miami-Dade County Inspector General serves as the School Board's Inspector General under an interlocal agreement extended through December 18, 2028 (item H-1, October 8, 2025): complaints at (305) 523-0623, 1501 NE 2nd Avenue Suite 343, or the OIG online fraud form.
levers.rules: The OIG's 2025 M-DCPS annual report: 50 complaints received in FY 2024-25, 74% through the website; OIG budget $1,219,043 funded by the School Board.

notes: No salary dataset, checkbook or vendor payment register is published on dadeschools.net; the district's transparency is the budget items, the Annual Financial Report and the FDOE staff spreadsheets. positionsTotal (30,841 full-time; 3,671 part-time) is the OIG's district statistic, period not stated in the 2025 report; the budget items fetched print no FTE or position totals and no prior-year comparison, so 'change' is null throughout. payrollTotal is General Fund salaries (object 100) actually spent in FY 2024-25 ($1,887,522,029.02); benefits were $772,586,149.26 and purchased services $1,332,293,781.86. byDepartment rows are General Fund salaries by function from the same report (no position counts by function are printed); the Central Office row is the district's own count from the June 10, 2026 workshop deck (1,118 employees, $149M). FY 2026-27 budget: General Fund appropriations $4,183,233,161; all funds $7,358,169,379; millage 6.623. highestPaidTitles is empty: the FDOE 'District Staff Salaries of Selected Positions' spreadsheet (pay by title) is an .xlsx the tools here could not open, and salary schedules are appendices to the labor contracts not posted as standalone pages found here. Vendors: the OIG total ($2,153,145,138 to 3,299 vendors) is the only yearly total found; the top list is contract award ceilings from three recent agendas, not payments, and covers 28 rows. UTD 2026-27 successor agreement, the FOP contract, and the Executive Summary budget book for FY 2025-26 and 2026-27 (robots-blocked) were not retrieved; mca.dadeschools.net is also robots-blocked. Sources saved under scratchpad payments-src (sb-*.txt).
